ownership.quote: Together AI — an AI neocloud that rents out Nvidia GPU clusters and other AI-specific infrastructure — has raised an $800 million Series C at an $8.3 billion valuation, the company announced on Wednesday.

stage.quote: Together AI … has raised an $800 million Series C at an $8.3 billion valuation
stage.note: Last priced round is the July 2026 Series C ($800M, $8.3B valuation).

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of confirmed rounds per TechCrunch: $102.5M Series A (2023) + $305M Series B (~March 2025, $3.3B valuation) + $800M Series C (July 2026, $8.3B valuation).
total_funding_usd.quote: Together AI last raised a $305 million Series B at a $3.3 billion valuation about 16 months ago. It actually came out of the gate well-funded, with a $102.5 million Series A funding round led by Kleiner Perkins with participation from Nvidia and Emergence Capital back in 2023.

last_round.quote: The round was led by Aramco Ventures, with participation from Vista Equity Partners, General Catalyst, Emergence Capital, Nvidia, March Capital, Pegatron, SentinelOne’s S Ventures, and others.

revenue.basis: Company-reported annualized bookings figure quoted by TechCrunch, not audited revenue.
revenue.quote: The hefty infusion of capital comes as Together AI claims annual bookings of over $1.15 billion as of its last quarter

note: Founded 2022 by Vipul Ved Prakash (CEO, previously sold Topsy to Apple), Percy Liang (Stanford) and Ce Zhang (ETH Zurich/UChicago). Neocloud/GPU-cloud and inference platform for open-source AI models; customers cited include Cursor, Cognition and Decagon.
